title: Trump Proposes Major SEC Shakeup: Quarterly Earnings Reports at Risk – How this Impacts Crypto Firms
summary: Trump has revived efforts to change quarterly disclosures to six-month updates, saying it reduces costs and short-term pressure. Supporters cite long-term focus, while others warn on transparency. Earnings data and reports for crypto-exposed firms could arrive less often, subject to SEC approval.
